vectors.hex: 02 61 62 ff ff ff ff ff ff ff ff ff ff ff ff ff ff ff ff ff ff ff ff ff ff ff ff ff ff ff ff 02 81 04 00 00 32 41 04 00 00 0a 4d
vectors.note: macro body: name 'ab' padded with ff to 30 bytes, 2 events (press A then 50 ms, release A then 10 ms); the checksum covers offset 31 to the end

vectors.name: kb cmd 3
vectors.note: keyboard online query; byte 4 carries the 0x80 keyboard flag

vectors.name: kb read 9408/10
vectors.note: keyboard flash read of 10 bytes at 9408 (settings block); length 0x0a with the 0x80 flag

vectors.name: kb Win+L slot
vectors.note: keyboard key slot [type, lo, hi, cks], little-endian: kind 7 (combination), modifiers 0x08 (Win) in lo, usage 0x0f (L) in hi

vectors.name: kb F1 slot 0x82
vectors.note: keyboard key slot with type 0x82: kind = type & 0x0f = 2 (HID usage), flag 0x80 set, usage 0x3a (F1)

vectors.name: kb SyncCRC entry (512 x ff)
vectors.note: CRC-32/IEEE of a 512-byte key layer filled with ff, big-endian in bytes 0-3, then 4 zero bytes; a CRC entry carries no additive checksum

vectors.name: kb SyncCRC write idx 0 (512 x ff)
vectors.note: the entry above written at 9504 (index 0, win normal layer); length 8 with the 0x80 flag

vectors.name: kb SyncCRC entry (counting 0..511)
vectors.note: CRC-32/IEEE of a synthetic 512-byte key layer whose byte i is i & 0xff, big-endian in bytes 0-3, then 4 zero bytes; the non-uniform input pins byte order and window; no additive checksum

vectors.name: kb SyncCRC write idx 0 (counting)
vectors.note: the counting entry above written at 9504 (index 0, win normal layer); length 8 with the 0x80 flag
